brainCore.title: Brain
brainCore.summary: Local AI second brain: a Markdown vault, a CLI, a web graph, and an MCP server, all on your machine.
brainCore.intro: Brain is a local second brain. The vault, the command line, the web graph, and the MCP server stay on the machine. Paste text, a link, or a screenshot and it becomes a note.
bullets: Markdown vault with wikilinks and tags, plus a CLI, a web graph, and an MCP server.
Capture turns pasted text, URLs, or screenshots into notes.
Runs locally, with Ollama by default, or Groq or Gemini.

Nauc-Me-To.title: NaučMěTo
Nauc-Me-To.summary: Upload study material and get a quiz, a cheat sheet, and flashcards generated from it.
Nauc-Me-To.intro: NaučMěTo takes a PDF, slides, or notes and turns them into a quiz, a cheat sheet, and flashcards. Each file keeps its notes and a workspace. Supabase handles the account, the files, and the database.
bullets: Upload a PDF, slides, or notes and get a quiz, a cheat sheet, and flashcards from the file.
Notes and a workspace sit with each document.
Supabase handles auth, storage, and the database.

plavanilavia.title: Plavecká škola Lavia
plavanilavia.summary: The school site at plavanilaviabrno.cz. Next.js, no database, hosted on Vercel.
plavanilavia.intro: The site for Plavecká škola Lavia. The season lives in the repository, staff edit it in the admin, and a save commits to GitHub so Vercel can rebuild.
bullets: Public site for Plavecká škola Lavia at plavanilaviabrno.cz.
Next.js on Vercel, with season content stored in the repository.
Staff edit that content in the admin page; a save commits to GitHub and Vercel rebuilds.

Strakata-Turistika-ANDROID.title: Strakatá turistika
Strakata-Turistika-ANDROID.summary: Flutter app for Strakatá turistika, built around GPS.
Strakata-Turistika-ANDROID.intro: Strakatá turistika is a Flutter app built around GPS. It is the mobile work on this page, active since January 2025.
bullets: Flutter application for Strakatá turistika, built around GPS.
Listed on LinkedIn as an active project since January 2025.

create-filip-app.title: Create Filip App
create-filip-app.summary: CLI that scaffolds a Next.js app with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
create-filip-app.intro: Create Filip App scaffolds Next.js with the App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Setup asks about components, the theme, and the package manager, then runs with npx create-filip-app.
bullets: Scaffolds Next.js with the App Router, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Interactive setup for components, themes, and the package manager.
Published to run with npx create-filip-app.
